description: A legacy policy without the calldata-enrichment keys preserves current behavior: a contract.call with raw calldata and an explicit zero amount approves under the ETH caps, and token caps continue to bind only token-declared intents. This is the documented residual the template-side allow_only amount rules and enrichment close.
